XMLDB.COMMENT: Tables for the AI quiz generator plugin.

TABLE.NAME: local_aiquiz_jobs
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per quiz generation request sent to the AI service.

FIELD.NAME: requestid
FIELD.COMMENT: The request_id sent to the service and returned by its callback.

FIELD.NAME: remotejobid
FIELD.COMMENT: The job_id the service assigned, kept so a job can be traced in its logs.

FIELD.NAME: filekeyid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user_private_key row of the job's temporary file download key, deleted when the job finishes.

FIELD.NAME: quizid
FIELD.COMMENT: The quiz instance waiting for questions.

FIELD.NAME: published
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 once the teacher has approved the quiz and made it visible to students.

FIELD.NAME: timepublished
FIELD.COMMENT: When the quiz was last published.

FIELD.NAME: errormessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Why the job failed, shown on the status page.

FIELD.NAME: params
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON of the generation settings submitted on the form.

INDEX.NAME: requestid
INDEX.COMMENT: Guarantees a job can only be completed once.
